Fridays on Fifth

5–9 p.m. · Fifth Avenue between Ninth and 11th streets, New Kensington

PRT proposes new New Kensington–Highlands Mall bus route

Last day for comments · Online

PRT's final Bus Line Redesign proposal adds 7-day N3 service linking New Kensington, Arnold, Tarentum, Brackenridge and Natrona Heights; comments due Sept. 30.

Every year

Early December, Saturday at 11 a.m. (December 6 in 2025)

City of New Kensington Christmas Parade

Fourth and Fifth avenues, downtown New Kensington

The yearly holiday parade with floats and local marching bands.

Source: static1.squarespace.com

December

Downtown tree lighting and Mayor's Annual Holiday Dinner

Downtown New Kensington; New Kensington Fire Department

A downtown tree lighting followed by the mayor's community holiday dinner at the fire department.

Source: Valley News Dispatch (TribLive)

Mid-March (the weekend before St. Patrick's Day), 11 a.m.

Lower Burrell St. Patrick's Day Parade

Leechburg Road, from Stewart Elementary School to Hillcrest Plaza, Lower Burrell

Started during the COVID-19 lockdown, the parade has grown to more than 40 participating groups.

Source: Valley News Dispatch (TribLive)

Summer

Lower Burrell Community Day

K-9 Officer Derek Kotecki Memorial Park, Lower Burrell

A day of food trucks, live entertainment and 45+ vendors that benefits Lower Burrell city parks. Organizers hope to make it a yearly event.

Source: Valley News Dispatch (TribLive)

Summer

Arts, Beats and Treats

AK Research Park (former Alcoa research center), Freeport Road, New Kensington

A summer festival at the rejuvenated Alcoa property, staged by owner Steve Kubrick. One edition featured a display of Alcoa Kensington Ware.

Source: Valley News Dispatch (TribLive)

Summer (June)

Skyy Moore Summer Jam

New Kensington

A yearly community event for local kids hosted by NFL receiver and New Kensington native Skyy Moore.

Source: Pittsburgh Post-Gazette

First weekend of August (Friday evening and Saturday)

Festa Italiana

Mount St. Peter Church, 100 Freeport Road, New Kensington

A volunteer-run Italian festival, held for more than 40 years, with thousands of homemade meatballs, lasagna, pizza and polenta, plus dancing, bingo and children's games.

Source: Valley News Dispatch (TribLive)

Public meetings

Arnold City Council meets the second Tuesday of each month at 7 p.m. The next expected meeting is Tuesday, Oct. 13.

Source: City of Arnold
